facility.name: The Seed Tree School
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Part Time Care

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records: Three staff folders reviewed during the inspection were missing the required information( training hours, photo identification, notarized affidavit, hire dates, background checks).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: There was no record of the required 30 hours of training for the primary caregiver available to review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: A total of 13 out of 30 required hours of training for primary caregiver was obtained via email on 6/13/25. The primary caregiver still lacks 17 hours in training hours. This assessment was approved by CCR supervisor Amy Johnson. The compliance date of 6/20/25 was changed to 6/27/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: A total of 13 out of 30 required hours of training for primary caregiver was obtained via email on 6/13/25. The primary caregiver still lacks 17 hours in training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: There was no documentation of required 30 hours of training for primary caregiver available to review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of 12 children records reviewed was missing current immunization record  during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: primary caregiver was observed caring for 12 children ages 9 months, 17 months, 17 months, 2 years, 2 years, 3 years, 3 years, 3 years, 3 years, 4 years, 4 years, and 4 years old during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: There was no record of required 30 hours of training for primary caregiver available to review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: This was recited when a 17 year old child of a caregiver was observed present in the room with the children without a valid background.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: The operation was observed out of ratio, when one caregiver was observed caring for nine children ages 20 months- 3 years old, and two 4-year olds during the inspection. This was corrected during the inspection when a second caregiver was observed returning to care for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: A electric fan was observed not mounted out of the reach of children during the inspection. This was corrected during the inspection when caregiver was observed unplugging, and removing the fan from the shelf out of the reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: The operation was observed out of ratio, when one caregiver was observed caring for nine children ages 18 months- 3 years old, and two 4-year olds during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed caring for children during the inspection without an approved background check. The caregiver was observed leaving the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Facility Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: Operation was observed extremely warm, and not well ventilated with thermostat showing temperature of 81 degrees during inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Facility Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §747.3203(11))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: Electric fans were observed not mounted out of the reach of children during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - adaptive equipment and instructions: Ten children records reviewed were missing information on any adaptive equipment provided for child including instructions for how to use the equipment during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - adaptive equipment and instructions (26 TAC §747.605(13)(B)(ii))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Reasonable accommodations or modifications: Ten children records reviewed were missing information on reasonable accomodations or modifications during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Reasonable accommodations or modifications (26 TAC §747.605(13)(B)(i))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: Epi-pens for two children in care were observed not labeled with child's full name and date it was brought to the operaqtion during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §747.3605(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Potential complications: Ten children files reviewed were missing information on symptoms or indications of potential complications related to a physical, cognitive, or mental condition that may warrant prevention or intervention while child is in care during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Potential complications (26 TAC §747.605(13)(B)(iii))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: Ten children records observed missing permssions for participation in water activities including whether child is able to swim without assistance. during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §747.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Supply Soap and Individual Towels: There were no individual towels or disposable towels observed in restroom for handwashing and drying during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supply Soap and Individual Towels (26 TAC §747.4205)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Fitted sheet in crib was observed too loose and not snuggly/tight fitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2309(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The use zones for stationary equipment was observed less than 6 feet in all directions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §747.4603)

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records: Two out of three staff folders reviewed during inspection was missing the required information( training hours, photo identification, notarized affidavit, hire dates, background checks).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)
